items: Start the video with the best part, not the logo. The first 2 seconds decide everything.
Pin the post that explains what you do best. Today, not Monday.
Reply to all your comments today. Yes, even the one with a single emoji.
Add captions. Many people watch on mute, on the tram or in a meeting.
Film vertically. Always. Even when it seems it doesn't matter.
Read your bio as a stranger would. Can you understand what you do in 3 seconds?
Did a post perform well? Make it again, but differently.
Write down three post ideas for next week today. Just three.
Look at saves, not likes. A save means “I want more.”
Show how it's done, not just the result. The process is content.
The best time to post is when you have something to say.
“Going viral” isn't a goal. It's a prayer.
A poster shared on Instagram is still a poster. Just a smaller one.
A good report takes 5 minutes to read. The rest is decoration.
The best ideas come during a walk, not at a third brainstorming session.
Today's trend expires tomorrow. A good idea doesn't.
The algorithm doesn't hate anyone. It just gets bored quickly.
If you wouldn't say it out loud, don't post it.
Film a 7-second clip today. No logo, no stock music.
Show your face in a story today. One is enough.
Rewrite the first sentence of your latest post. Make it shorter.
Take a photo of something at your desk you've never shown before.
Comment on 5 accounts in your niche today. Sincerely, not just “great!”
One hour without scrolling. Then notice what you really missed.
The free list we use for NA Audits is yours. Take it.
Today is your lucky day. Write to us for a mini public audit and we might choose you.
Someone needs a compliment for their feed today. Give it to them.
A small account isn't a weak account. It's a beginning.
Thank a client today. In public.
If you made it this far, you're our kind of person.
